key.name: shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that starts an area screenshot

key.name: take-print
key.summary: Print opens RicingScreenshots instead of GNOME's screenshot tool
key.description: Borrows whatever key GNOME uses to take a screenshot while the extension is on; GNOME's settings are not changed.

key.name: record-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that records an area of the screen with the system sound; pressed again it stops

key.name: record-pipeline
key.summary: Internal: the encoder that last worked on this computer

key.name: toggle-message-tray
key.summary: Internal: GNOME's notification list keys minus the recording shortcut
key.description: Written by the extension while it holds a key GNOME also uses for the notification list; not a setting.

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Color of the selection frame and the active tool

key.name: dim-opacity
key.summary: How much the screen outside the selection is darkened

key.name: ask-to-edit
key.summary: After a capture, ask whether to edit it

key.name: show-notification
key.summary: Show a notification when a screenshot is copied

key.name: pen-width
key.summary: Last used line width, in logical pixels
